column4: dialect-gated: cmd/cleat-worker/a_drop_plan_counts_a_tenants_rows_test.go's SQL Server arm needs CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL, which this job (./cmd/..., CLEAT_TEST_DB only) does not supply. The PostgreSQL arm and the HTTP gating tests run here.
